verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ עַֽל־ נְגִינַ֬ת לְדָוִֽד׃ שִׁמְעָ֣ה רִנָּתִ֑י אֱ֭לֹהִים הַ֝קְשִׁ֗יבָה תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- nə·ḡî·naṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ šim·‘āh rin·nā·ṯî ’ĕ·lō·hîm haq·šî·ḇāh tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments Of David Hear my cry O God attend to my prayer

verses.original: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ אֶ֭קְרָא אֵלֶ֣יךָ לִבִּ֑י בַּעֲטֹ֣ף תַנְחֵֽנִי׃ בְּצוּר־ יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי
verses.transliteration: miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ ’eq·rā ’ê·le·ḵā lib·bî ba·‘ă·ṭōp̄ ṯan·ḥê·nî bə·ṣūr- yā·rūm mim·men·nî
verses.literal: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint Lead me to the rock [that] is higher than I

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־ עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hā·yî·ṯā maḥ·seh lî miḡ·dal- ‘ōz mip·pə·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: For You have been my refuge a tower of strength against the enemy

verses.original: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.literal: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings Selah

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh šā·ma‘·tā lin·ḏā·rāy ’ĕ·lō·hîm nā·ṯa·tā yə·ruš·šaṯ yir·’ê šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: For You have heard my vows O God You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name

verses.original: תּוֹסִ֑יף יָמִ֣ים עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְמֵי־ שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ־ דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·sîp̄ yā·mîm ‘al- me·leḵ yə·mê- šə·nô·t̲āyw kə·mōw- ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: Increase the days of the king’s life may his years . . . span many generations . . .

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֣ב אֱלֹהִ֑ים לִפְנֵ֣י ע֭וֹלָם מַ֣ן חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yê·šêḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·nê ‘ō·w·lām man ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ yin·ṣə·ru·hū
verses.literal: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן לָעַ֑ד אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְדָרַ֗י י֣וֹם׀ יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kên lā·‘aḏ ’ă·zam·mə·rāh šim·ḵā lə·šal·lə·mî nə·ḏā·ray yō·wm yō·wm
verses.literal: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day
